verdict.rationale: Self-hosting under an open-source license is a fair question for a design platform, so the axis applies. The evidence describes only a hosted, subscription-based Anthropic service with no self-hosted deployment or open-source license documented. HTML/PDF/PPTX export and data export are adjacent features, not self-hosting.

support.subject: As a developer, I can self-host the full design platform on my own infrastructure under an open-source license
